purpose: Reduce coordination latency by separating acknowledgement, execution, handoff, review, integration, and final-player judgment while preserving exact identity and proof gates.

tiers.exit: each eligible row is dispatchable or has one typed owner/dependency/resumption exemption
clean checkpoint or typed blocker on the first legal deliverable
ACK or exact exemption for every dispatched cell within one coordination round
candidateIdentity, observedHead, resultHead, focusedReceipt, readiness tuple, and nextGateOwner are complete
one PASS/RETURN per exact candidate with defect paths or join-ready evidence
one exact aggregate candidate or one typed frontier decision
immutable independent result bound to the exact aggregate

handoffContract.ackHead: clean HEAD observed when the visible task acknowledges the route before mutation
handoffContract.observedHead: immutable HEAD against which focused work actually ran
handoffContract.resultHead: clean commit returned by the worker; may differ from observedHead only by the claimed evidence-only receipt diff
handoffContract.identityRule: never overwrite ackHead with resultHead and never rewrite historical job heads
handoffContract.noAckAction: return typed acknowledgement failure and refill a disjoint legal row in the same turn
handoffContract.returnedCandidateAction: enqueue T1 handoff and T2 review immediately; preserve passing siblings unchanged

fastPath.reviewQueueParallelism: review disjoint candidate rows concurrently; one compact receipt per row
fastPath.neverIdle: If a row waits, assign stage-legal preparation or emit one exact exemption; do not poll or manufacture work.

hardGates: one full suite and staged build for the exact aggregate
